text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: FinalBurn Neo is an arcade emulator focused on accuracy and compatibility with a wide range of arcade systems. It continues the development of the Final Burn Alpha project and supports hardware including Capcom CPS systems, Neo Geo, Sega arcade boards, and many other arcade platforms. The emulator is widely used for preserving arcade games and maintaining compatibility with large arcade game collections.
